title: Migration Hub
introduction: Migration Hub is your centralized platform for managing migrations between IBM Cloud products and services. Access expert guidance, migration tools, and real-time status tracking for transitions like Classic Infrastructure to VPC, Cloud Foundry to Code Engine, and deprecated services to modern replacements.

section_highlights.title: Migrating from Classic Infrastructure to VPC
section_highlights.description: Learn how to transition your workloads from IBM Cloud Classic Infrastructure to Virtual Private Cloud for enhanced security and performance.

section_highlights.title: Cloud Foundry to Code Engine Migration Guide
section_highlights.description: Step-by-step guidance for migrating your Cloud Foundry applications to IBM Cloud Code Engine.
